title: Run a Repair and Parts Shop Without the Paperwork
summary: Price parts for profit after fees, list them faster and keep orders and quotes in one place, so a small repair shop spends its time at the bench.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already sell parts on eBay; the value is admin time saved and prices that cover fees.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Every part is priced to make money after fees and shipping.
Less time on listings, tracking and quotes.
who_its_for: Small computer and phone repair shops.
Resellers who buy and sell parts on eBay.

steps.name: Computer Shop Bot
steps.does: Prices for profit and tracks orders

outputs: Parts priced to profit after fees
Orders and quotes in one place

steps: Enter your fee and shipping costs once.
Photograph parts and get listing drafts.
Check each price against sold comps and your costs.
Track orders and send quotes after you review them.
guardrails: You approve every purchase, listing and quote.
Check part compatibility yourself before quoting a customer.
